definitions.explanation: The part of a road designated for vehicles, as opposed to sidewalks for pedestrians.

examples.japanese: {車道|しゃどう}を⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧のは⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧です。
examples.english: It's dangerous to walk on the roadway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧は{車道|しゃどう}を⟦{走|はし}らなければならない→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: Bicycles must ride on the roadway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧が{車道|しゃどう}に⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}した→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧。
examples.english: A child ran out onto the roadway.

examples.japanese: ここは{車道|しゃどう}と⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧が⟦{分|わ}かれていない→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Here the roadway and sidewalk are not separated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧のため、{車道|しゃどう}の⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧が⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧になっている。
examples.english: Part of the roadway is closed due to construction.

notes:
{車道|しゃどう} combines {車|しゃ} (vehicle) + {道|どう} (road/way).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧ (sidewalk) - antonym
- ⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧ (lane)
- ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧ (road)
- {国道|こくどう} (national highway)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {車道|しゃどう}を⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to drive on the roadway)
- {車道|しゃどう}に⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to go onto the roadway)
- {車道|しゃどう}と⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧ (roadway and sidewalk)

USAGE:
- In Japan, bicycles are legally required to use {車道|しゃどう} in most cases
- Important vocabulary for traffic safety and driving
